messages:
Mira: Quick sync — two customers asked for a single embeddings endpoint that accepts mixed-dimension requests (clients send items wanting 1536, 3072, or 4096 dims in the same call). They also requested larger per-request counts (up to ~2k items) and a stable response format for SDKs. Can eng-platform + eng-ml assess risk & propose a rollout plan?

Leo: Quick take — doable but several concerns: memory and GC spikes on large batches, model selection complexity (which model serves which dim), and compatibility with current SDKs. Need to decide on response schema (per-item dim metadata) and hard limits for alpha.

Sam: Architect notes — two viable approaches:
1) Endpoint returns per-item metadata + vector bytes: keep single API but require server-side chunking to safe batch sizes.
2) Versioned payload: introduce format_version=v2 that supports mixed dims; v1 remains unchanged.

Suggested response schema (proposal):
```json
{
  "format_version": "v2",
  "results": [
    {"id": "item-123", "model": "rw-embed-4096", "dimension": "4096", "vector_base64": "...", "quantized": "fp16"},
    {"id": "item-456", "model": "rw-embed-1536", "dimension": "1536", "vector_base64": "...", "quantized": "int8"}
  ]
}
```
Notes: base64 keeps JSON safe, quantized flag allows clients to decode correctly.

Elaine: Ops constraints — chunking required. We should cap per-request processing to 512 items in a single worker to avoid OOM. Implement per-tenant max_batch config (default 512, enterprise opt-in up to 2048 with Dedicated capacity). Also need telemetry: track "batch_item_count", "avg_dim", "mem_peak".

Mira: Product asks — backward compatibility is critical. Customers using SDKs must not break. So default should stay v1 behavior; v2 opt-in header `X-Embeddings-Format: v2` or query param. Launch criteria: two enterprise pilot customers signed off on SDK changes, perf within 1.2x p95 of current for common payloads, and full e2e tests.

Leo: Implementation plan I propose:
- Phase 1 (alpha): add v2 schema + server-side chunking. Enable for internal + pilot tenants. Hard cap per worker 512.
- Phase 2: add per-tenant config + Dedicated opt-in for 2048.
- Phase 3: optimize memory (streaming encode, avoid full float32 expansion), add quantized paths.

Sam: Routing/model selection — if user requests a dim we don't host, options: refuse with 400, or map to nearest model and upsample/downsample. Prefer explicit: require supported dims, but allow automatic mapping with a warning in v2. Need an API in the model catalog: supported_dims -> model_id.

Elaine: Security/observability tasks — add quota / rate-limits by item count, block large spikes in free-tier. Add CI perf job that simulates mixed-dim batches and measures p95/p99 and memory.

Mira: Product asks for rollout checklist bullets we can sign-off on with customers: 1) v2 docs + SDK patch, 2) pilot with 2 customers + perf results, 3) migration guide (how to opt-in/out), 4) clear errors for unsupported dims.

Leo: Accepting those. Perf gates: p99 <= 2x baseline for extreme mixed cases, p95 <= 1.2x for typical. If we hit p99 regressions we gate the rollout.

Sam: Dev notes: implementation will add ~3 new API unit tests + 2 perf harness scripts. Need a small data migration? No. Model catalog entries only.

Mira: Timeline ask — can eng-platform get an initial alpha by EOW+3wks? Customers waiting.

Leo: EOW+3wks is tight but feasible for alpha if we scope: v2 schema + server-side chunking + pilot toggle, no quantization in alpha.

Elaine: I'll add the CI perf job and telemetry dashboard ticket.

deploy-bot: CI pipeline: `perf/mixed-dim-embeddings` job created, triggers on PR label `perf/embeddings`.

Mira: Great — thanks team. I'll draft the pilot invite and SDK change notes. @Sam can you please write a short sample response snippet for the SDK team to use in examples?

Sam: Yup, will post snippet in #eng-ml tomorrow. :+1:
